principle_violations.reason: The Order class has multiple responsibilities: managing items, calculating total price, and handling payment processing.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment processing logic into a dedicated PaymentProcessor class to adhere to the single responsibility principle.

principle_violations.reason: The pay method requires modification to add new payment methods (e.g., PayPal) directly, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a Payment interface and create subclasses for each payment method. This way, the Order class can depend on an abstraction rather than modifying its implementation.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
